headline: Dissolved SOE Debt Could Be Subject to Zero Rupiah Tax, Here Are the Requirements!
summary: Indonesia has introduced a 0% final income tax for state-owned enterprises that restructure debt, under PP 41/2026. The facility can apply until 2029 subject to specific conditions.
why: State-owned enterprises are major borrowers and issuers in Indonesia, so tax treatment of debt write-offs affects their balance sheets and creditor outcomes.
original_headline: Utang BUMN Dihapus Bisa Kena Pajak Nol Rupiah, Ini Syaratnya!
